title: AWS Cloud Architecture Mastery Test
description: Test your knowledge of core AWS services: IAM policies, EC2, S3, RDS, VPC networking, Lambda serverless, and CloudWatch.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between an AWS Security Group and a Network Access Control List (NACL)?
options: Security Groups are stateful and operate at the EC2 instance level; NACLs are stateless and operate at the Subnet level
NACLs are stateful while Security Groups are stateless
Security Groups only filter outbound traffic
NACLs can only be applied to S3 buckets
questions.explanation: Security Groups are stateful (inbound return traffic is allowed automatically) and attach to ENIs; NACLs are stateless rules applied to subnet boundaries.

questions.question: Which AWS S3 storage class is best suited for data accessed less than once a month but requiring millisecond retrieval when requested?
options: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
S3 Glacier Deep Archive
S3 Standard
S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval
questions.explanation: S3 Standard-IA offers low storage pricing with rapid millisecond access for data accessed infrequently.

questions.question: In AWS IAM, what is the best practice for granting temporary permissions to an application running on an EC2 instance to access S3?
options: Attach an IAM Role directly to the EC2 Instance Profile using AWS STS temporary credentials
Hard-code IAM User Access Key and Secret Key in an `.env` file on the instance
Store the root AWS account password in an S3 bucket
Make the S3 bucket publicly readable and writable
questions.explanation: IAM Roles automatically rotate temporary session credentials through the EC2 metadata service without storing hard-coded keys on disk.

questions.question: What is the maximum execution duration (timeout) for a single AWS Lambda function invocation?
options: 15 minutes
5 minutes
1 hour
24 hours
questions.explanation: AWS Lambda functions have a hard execution timeout limit of 15 minutes (900 seconds) per invocation.

questions.question: In Amazon RDS, what is the primary benefit of deploying a Multi-AZ DB instance compared to a Read Replica?
options: Multi-AZ provides synchronous replication and automatic failover for high availability; Read Replicas provide asynchronous read scaling
Multi-AZ is used only for data analytics queries
Read Replicas handle synchronous write transactions
Multi-AZ reduces database storage costs by 50%
questions.explanation: Multi-AZ maintains a standby replica in a secondary availability zone with synchronous writes and automatic DNS failover in under 2 minutes.

questions.question: What AWS service acts as a Content Delivery Network (CDN) to cache web assets globally at edge locations?
options: Amazon CloudFront
Amazon Route 53
AWS Direct Connect
Amazon API Gateway
questions.explanation: CloudFront securely distributes static and dynamic web content with low latency via a worldwide network of edge point-of-presence (PoP) locations.

questions.question: In an AWS VPC, what component connects a VPC subnet directly to the public internet?
options: Internet Gateway (IGW)
Egress-Only Gateway
VPC Peering Connection
Virtual Private Gateway
questions.explanation: An Internet Gateway attached to a VPC provides a target in subnet route tables for internet-bound IPv4/IPv6 traffic.

questions.question: What is the difference between Amazon SQS and Amazon SNS?
options: SQS is a pull-based distributed message queuing service for decoupled worker polling; SNS is a push-based pub/sub notification service
SNS stores messages in FIFO queues for 14 days
SQS only sends emails and SMS texts
They are identical services with different pricing
questions.explanation: SQS holds messages until consumers poll and process them; SNS fans out published messages instantly to multiple subscriber endpoints (HTTP, Lambda, SQS).

questions.question: What AWS service allows defining cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages like TypeScript, Python, or Java?
options: AWS CDK (Cloud Development Kit)
AWS CloudFormation Designer
AWS OpsWorks
AWS Elastic Beanstalk
questions.explanation: AWS CDK lets developers define cloud resources using object-oriented code which compiles (synthesizes) down to standard CloudFormation templates.

questions.question: In AWS Auto Scaling, what is a 'Cooldown Period'?
options: A configurable time window during which Auto Scaling does not launch or terminate additional instances, allowing new instances to stabilize and metrics to settle
The time required for an EC2 CPU to physically cool down
The delay when launching an instance in winter regions
The time before terminated instance data is wiped from disk
questions.explanation: Cooldown periods prevent Auto Scaling from overcompensating and thrashing instances before previous scaling activities have taken effect.
